arXiv:2607.09526v1 [cs.CV] 2026 年 7 月 10 日arXiv:2607.09526v1 [cs.CV] 10 Jul 2026

ALICE：向视觉、视觉语言和载玻片专家学习通用病理学基础模型ALICE: Learning a General-Purpose Pathology Foundation Model from Vision, Vision-Language, and Slide-Level Experts

Jiawen Li1∗    Tian Guan1∗    Huijuan Shi3∗    Xitong Ling1    Mingxi Fu1    Anjia Han3+    Chao He2+    Yonghong He1,4+
摘要Abstract

摘要Abstract

基础模型正在重塑计算病理学，但它们的能力仍然受到预训练目标、数据源和空间尺度的影响，将互补的专业知识分散到不同的骨干网中。在这里，我们提出了 ALICE，这是一个通过多阶段凝聚蒸馏训练​​的统一基础模型，它依次将八个仅视觉、视觉语言和幻灯片级别的教师模型蒸馏为单个主干的专用模块。 ALICE 经过 24,985,184 个切片级病理图像和 155,604 个高分辨率图像的预训练，并在 21 个任务场景、96 个下游任务和 48 个数据源中进行评估，涵盖感兴趣区域组织分析、视觉语言多模态评估和全幻灯片临床评估。在所有三种评估设置中，ALICE 在任务匹配的病理学基础模型中取得了最佳平均排名。这些结果表明，凝聚蒸馏可以将专门模型的互补功能整合为广泛计算病理学应用的统一主干。该模型可从 https://github.com/WonderLandxD/ALICE 获取。Foundation models are reshaping computational pathology, yet their capabilities remain shaped by pretraining objectives, data sources, and spatial scales, fragmenting complementary expertise across separate backbones. Here we present ALICE, a unified foundation model trained through multi-stage agglomerative distillation that sequentially distills eight vision-only, vision–language, and slide-level teacher models into dedicated modules of a single backbone. ALICE is pretrained on 24,985,184 tile-level pathology images and 155,604 high-resolution images, and evaluated across 21 task scenarios, 96 downstream tasks, and 48 data sources, spanning region-of-interest tissue analysis, vision–language multimodal evaluation, and whole-slide clinical assessment. In all three evaluation settings, ALICE achieved the best average rank among task-matched pathology foundation models. These results demonstrate that agglomerative distillation can consolidate complementary capabilities from specialized models into a unified backbone for broad computational pathology applications. The model is available at https://github.com/WonderLandxD/ALICE.

1 简介Introduction

组织的组织病理学评估仍然是临床肿瘤学的基石，为许多癌症类型的诊断、预后和治疗决策奠定了基础Histopathological assessment of tissue remains the cornerstone of clinical oncology, forming the basis for diagnostic, prognostic, and treatment decisions across many cancer types55。将载玻片数字化为全载玻片图像 (WSI) 为开发可大规模增强病理学分析的计算工具创造了前所未有的机会. Digitizing slides into whole-slide images (WSIs) has created unprecedented opportunities to develop computational tools that enhance pathology analysis at scale71, 41。先前的深度学习方法已显示出在肿瘤检测、分子生物标志物预测和生存分析等特定任务中的潜力. Prior deep learning methods have shown potential for specific tasks such as tumor detection, molecular biomarker prediction, and survival analysis28, 10, 61, 75。然而，这些模型中的大多数都是从头开始针对特定任务（通常是小型标记群体）进行训练，限制了它们的性能和泛化能力。通过自我监督或多模式学习在大量组织病理学数据集上进行预训练的大型基础模型从根本上改变了这种范式，提供了可转移的视觉表示，适用于各种下游临床任务，并大大减少了注释要求. However, most of these models are trained from scratch on task-specific, typically small labeled cohorts, limiting their performance and generalization capabilities. Large-scale foundation models pretrained on massive histopathology datasets through self-supervised or multimodal learning have fundamentally changed this paradigm, providing transferable vision representations adaptable to a wide range of downstream clinical tasks with substantially reduced annotation requirements11, 39, 69, 67。因此，越来越多的病理学基础模型（PFM）被开发出来，在不同的临床应用中展示了巨大的潜力。. Consequently, a growing number of pathology foundation models (PFMs) have been developed, demonstrating substantial potential across diverse clinical applications.

尽管现有的 PFM 的共同目标是学习通用表示，但它们是在不同的预训练范式下开发的，从而导致了不同但分散的功能Despite their common goal of learning general-purpose representations, existing PFMs are developed under different pretraining paradigms, leading to distinct but fragmented capabilities45, 58。例如，纯视觉模型，如 UNI. For instance, vision-only models, such as UNI11和魏尔啸and Virchow63，依靠自我监督学习来捕获密集的形态表示，但它们缺乏与病理概念和语言级语义的明确一致性。视觉语言模型，例如 CONCH, rely on self-supervised learning to capture dense morphological representations, but they lack explicit alignment with pathological concepts and language-level semantics. Vision-language models, such as CONCH39和麝香and MUSK65，依靠多模态对比或生成学习来使视觉特征与文本语义保持一致，但它们在细粒度的视觉辨别任务上表现不佳, rely on multimodal contrastive or generative learning to align visual features with textual semantics, but they underperform on fine-grained visual discrimination tasks9。幻灯片级模型，例如 GigaPath. Slide-level models, such as GigaPath67和泰坦and TITAN15，依靠整个幻灯片背景或微弱的临床信号来捕获全局组织信息，但它们的实际可转移性仍然受到限制，因为它们可能难以微调或对于广泛的下游用途表达不足。因此，现有的模型没有一致地涵盖病理学任务所需的全部形态学、语义和幻灯片级功能。, rely on whole-slide context or weak clinical signals to capture global tissue information, but their practical transferability remains constrained, as they can be difficult to fine-tune or insufficiently expressive for broad downstream use. Therefore, no existing model consistently covers the full spectrum of morphological, semantic, and slide-level capabilities required across pathology tasks.

解决这种碎片化的自然方法是使用统一的架构来集成这些功能。在一般计算机视觉社区中，凝聚模型A natural way to address this fragmentation is to use a unified architecture to integrate these capabilities. In the general computer vision community, agglomerative models23, 73已经表明，接受过不同目标培训的专家可以被提炼成一个统一的骨干网，将预训练的模型视为补充知识源，而不是孤立的替代品。在计算病理学中，GPFMhave shown that experts trained with distinct objectives can be distilled into a unified backbone, treating pretrained models as complementary knowledge sources rather than isolated alternatives. In computational pathology, GPFM42迈出了第一步，表明统一的知识提炼可以提高 PFM 在不同临床任务中的泛化。然而，病理学专业知识涵盖局部形态、语言一致的诊断概念和整个幻灯片的临床背景。现有的蒸馏框架主要增强了一般的视觉表示，但没有通过临床抽象的模式、规模和水平来明确组织这些异质的专业知识来源。因此，为了构建真正通用的 PFM，需要一种更加结构化的聚合策略，将互补的专家知识逐步吸收到单个主干中。has provided a first step by showing that unified knowledge distillation can improve the generalization of PFMs across diverse clinical tasks. However, pathology expertise spans local morphology, language-aligned diagnostic concepts, and whole-slide clinical context. Existing distillation frameworks primarily strengthen general visual representations but do not explicitly organize these heterogeneous sources of expertise by modality, scale, and level of clinical abstraction. Thus, to build a truly general-purpose PFM, a more structured aggregation strategy is required to absorb complementary expert knowledge step by step into a single backbone.

在这里，我们介绍通过集成计算病理学嵌入（ALICE）进行的凝聚学习，这是一种通用组织病理学基础模型，可为跨越感兴趣区域（ROI）组织分析、视觉语言对齐和全幻灯片临床分析的各种计算病理学任务提供统一的表示。 ALICE 通过多阶段凝聚蒸馏策略进行训练，使用 24,985,184 个低分辨率和 155,604 个高分辨率组织病理学图像，并以在不同数据源、学习目标和空间尺度下训练的八个病理学基础模型作为教师（Here, we introduce Agglomerative Learning via Integrated Computational pathology Embedding (ALICE), a general-purpose histopathology foundation model that provides a unified representation for diverse computational pathology tasks spanning region-of-interest (ROI) tissue analysis, vision-language alignment, and whole-slide clinical analysis. ALICE is trained through a multi-stage agglomerative distillation strategy using 24,985,184 low-resolution and 155,604 high-resolution histopathology images, with eight pathology foundation models trained under different data sources, learning objectives, and spatial scales serving as teachers (图Figure1交流a-c）。具体来说，ALICE 首先从三个仅视觉模型 UNI-2 中学习面向形态的视觉表示). Specifically, ALICE first learns morphology-oriented visual representations from three vision-only models, UNI-211, Virchow-2 77，和 H-Opt-1, and H-Opt-150。然后，它结合了来自三种视觉语言模型的语言对齐表示，CONCH. It then incorporates language-aligned representations from three vision-language models, CONCH39, 麝香, MUSK65，并保持, and KEEP72，使组织模式与以自然语言表达的诊断概念相关联。最后，ALICE 从两个幻灯片级模型 TITAN 中学习整个幻灯片的上下文表示, enabling tissue patterns to be associated with diagnostic concepts expressed in natural language. Finally, ALICE learns whole-slide contextual representations from two slide-level models, TITAN15和关怀and CARE70，将其适用性从局部组织分析扩展到直接 WSI 水平分析。, extending its applicability from local tissue analysis to direct WSI-level analysis.

为了评估 ALICE，我们建立了一个围绕三个互补评估设置组织的综合基准：仅视觉、视觉语言多模态和幻灯片级分析。该基准测试涵盖 21 个任务场景，包括跨 48 个数据源的 96 个下游任务（To evaluate ALICE, we establish a comprehensive benchmark organized around three complementary evaluation settings: vision-only, vision-language multimodal, and slide-level analysis. The benchmark spans 21 task scenarios, comprising 96 downstream tasks across 48 data sources (图Figure1d-fd–f）。在所有三种评估设置中，ALICE 在任务匹配的 PFM 中取得了最佳平均排名，比第二好的模型高出 1.79、6.39 和 3.04 个百分点。与所有其余模型的平均性能相比，ALICE 的性能分别进一步提高了 3.10、7.41 和 4.00 个百分点。这些结果表明，结构化凝聚蒸馏可以将形态导向、语言对齐和整个幻灯片上下文专业知识整合到一个框架中，将 ALICE 建立为广泛适用的数字病理学基础模型。). Across all three evaluation settings, ALICE achieved the best average rank among task-matched PFMs, exceeding the second-best model by 1.79, 6.39, and 3.04 percentage points. Compared with the average performance of all remaining models, ALICE further improved performance by 3.10, 7.41, and 4.00 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate that structured agglomerative distillation can consolidate morphology-oriented, language-aligned, and whole-slide contextual expertise into a single framework, establishing ALICE as a broadly applicable foundation model for digital pathology.

2 结果Results

2.1 ALICE 在视觉特征迁移方面优于纯视觉 PFMALICE outperforms vision-only PFMs in visual feature transfer

我们首先在仅视觉特征传输设置中评估 ALICE，这是计算病理学中的常见部署场景，其中来自 WSI 的 ROI 或低分辨率图块被编码为嵌入，以用于下游诊断、检索和分割任务We first evaluated ALICE in a vision-only feature transfer setting, a common deployment scenario in computational pathology in which ROIs or low-resolution tiles from WSIs are encoded into embeddings for downstream diagnostic, retrieval, and segmentation tasks11。我们使用每个 PFM 作为冻结特征提取器，并直接或使用轻量级任务特定适配器评估生成的嵌入。在七个代表性评估场景中将 ALICE 与 UNI-2、Virchow-2、H-Opt-1 和 GPFM 进行了比较，包括 ROI 分类、图像到图像检索、ROI 语义和实例分割、少样本分类以及使用多实例学习 (MIL) 的弱监督 WSI 诊断分类。. We used each PFM as a frozen feature extractor and assessed the resulting embeddings either directly or with lightweight task-specific adapters. ALICE was compared with UNI-2, Virchow-2, H-Opt-1, and GPFM across seven representative evaluation scenarios, including ROI classification, image-to-image retrieval, ROI semantic and instance segmentation, few-shot classification, and weakly supervised WSI diagnostic classification using multiple instance learning (MIL).

在投资回报率水平上，ALICE 在不同的评估协议中表现出最强的整体可移植性（At the ROI level, ALICE showed the strongest overall transferability across diverse evaluation protocols (图Figure2a）。 ALICE 在线性探测和 KNN 分类设置下均取得了最佳平均排名，平均排名分别为 1.25 和 1.58。 ALICE 在图像到图像检索方面也排名第一，基于 MVAcc@5 的平均排名为 1.33。尽管 ALICE 在 PMT 设置下的 ROI 实例分割中的表现略低于 UNI-2（0.599 与 0.607，AP@50），但它仍然在七个分割任务中取得了最佳总体排名。详细的每个数据集 ROI 分类、检索和分割结果提供于). ALICE achieved the best average ranks under both linear probing and KNN classification settings, with average ranks of 1.25 and 1.58, respectively. ALICE also ranked first in image-to-image retrieval, with an average rank of 1.33 based on MVAcc@5. Although ALICE performed slightly below UNI-2 in ROI instance segmentation under the PMT setting (0.599 versus 0.607, AP@50), it still achieved the best overall rank across the seven segmentation tasks. Detailed per-dataset ROI classification, retrieval and segmentation results are provided in扩展数据图Extended Data Figure2和and扩展数据表Extended Data Table32-35。 ALICE 的优势在数据高效和非参数传输设置中也尤为明显。在少数样本分类中，ALICE 在 12 个 ROI 任务中取得了 1.08 的总体平均排名，比第二好的模型高出 1.50 个排名位置，并且在乳腺癌亚型和结直肠息肉分类中的所有样本数中始终超过 GPFM（. The advantage of ALICE was also particularly pronounced in data-efficient and non-parametric transfer settings. In few-shot classification, ALICE achieved an overall average rank of 1.08 across 12 ROI tasks, outperforming the second-best model by 1.50 rank positions, and consistently surpassed GPFM across all shot numbers in both breast carcinoma subtyping and colorectal polyp classification (图Figure2b，详细结果可参见, detailed results can be found in扩展数据图Extended Data Figure3和and扩展数据表Extended Data Table36-47）。在跨源图像到图像检索中，ALICE 比 GPFM 更可靠地检索形态和诊断上匹配的组织区域（). In cross-source image-to-image retrieval, ALICE more reliably retrieved morphologically and diagnostically matched tissue regions than GPFM (图Figure2c）。 UMAP 可视化进一步显示结直肠和食管胃组织分型任务中 ALICE 特征的清晰分类（). UMAP visualization further showed clear class-wise separation of ALICE features in colorectal and oesophagogastric tissue typing tasks (图Figure2d).

为了研究 ALICE 提取的低分辨率图像特征是否可以支持标准的弱监督幻灯片级诊断工作流程，我们进一步使用 ABMILTo investigate whether the low-resolution image features extracted by ALICE can support a standard weakly supervised slide-level diagnostic workflow, we further used ABMIL26作为 WSI 派生图块图像的特征聚合器。我们在 19 项临床 WSI 分类任务中评估了这一设置，涵盖早期癌症检测、肿瘤分型和分级以及中枢神经系统的亚专业诊断。 ALICE 在 17 项任务上的评估 PFM 中取得了最佳性能，并在 12 项任务上显着优于第二好的模型（as a feature aggregator for WSI-derived tile images. We evaluated this setting across 19 clinical WSI classification tasks spanning early cancer detection, tumor typing and grading, and subspecialty diagnosis of the central nervous system. ALICE achieved best performance among the evaluated PFMs on 17 tasks and significantly outperformed the second-best model on 12 tasks (图Figure2e和and扩展数据表Extended Data Table48）。这些结果表明，ALICE 的优势不仅限于 ROI 级表示学习，还可以在与标准 MIL 聚合器结合时转化为改进的弱监督 WSI 分类。). These results indicate that the advantages of ALICE are not limited to ROI-level representation learning, but can also be translated into improved weakly supervised WSI classification when combined with the standard MIL aggregator.

2.2 ALICE 在文本和视觉特征方面优于多模态 PFMALICE outperforms multimodal PFMs with text and vision features

病理学解释本质上是多模式的，需要将视觉形态学与诊断术语、文字描述和临床信息相结合Pathology interpretation is inherently multimodal, requiring the integration of visual morphology with diagnostic terminology, textual descriptions, and clinical information1。通过将低分辨率组织病理学图像特征与文本表示对齐并将其转移到下游任务，多模态 PFM 可以支持比纯视觉模型更广泛的诊断工作流程，包括零样本分类、跨模态检索、视觉问答 (VQA) 和文本引导的 WSI 分析。我们将 ALICE 与 MUSK、KEEP 和 CONCH 进行了比较，并在七个代表性的多模态任务场景中对其进行了基准测试：ROI 零样本分类、ROI 图像到文本和文本到图像检索、ROI VQA、WSI 零样本分类、WSI 少样本分类和多模态 WSI 临床预测。. By aligning low-resolution histopathology image features with textual representations and transferring them to downstream tasks, multimodal PFMs can support a broader range of diagnostic workflows than vision-only models, including zero-shot classification, cross-modal retrieval, visual question answering (VQA), and text-guided WSI analysis. We compared ALICE with MUSK, KEEP, and CONCH, and benchmarked it across seven representative multimodal task scenarios: ROI zero-shot classification, ROI image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval, ROI VQA, WSI zero-shot classification, WSI few-shot classification, and multimodal WSI clinical prediction.

在ROI设置中，ALICE取得了最佳的整体表现（In the ROI setting, ALICE achieved the best overall performance (图Figure3a），在 12 个零样本分类任务中排名第一，基于平衡精度的平均排名为 1.50。它还在图像到文本和文本到图像检索方面在三个数据源中取得了最佳平均排名，基于recall@50，平均排名为1.17。此外，ALICE 在 ROI VQA 中取得了最佳平均排名，在 10 项任务中的 6 项中优于竞争模型，总体平均排名达到 1.87。这些结果表明，ALICE 学习协调的视觉和文本表示，并推广到语言引导的病理解释。更详细的 ROI 视觉语言迁移结果显示在), ranking first across 12 zero-shot classification tasks with an average rank of 1.50 based on balanced accuracy. It also achieved the best average rank across three data sources in image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval, with an average rank of 1.17 based on recall@50. Furthermore, ALICE achieved the best average rank in ROI VQA, outperforming competing models in 6 of 10 tasks and reaching an overall average rank of 1.87. These results demonstrate that ALICE learns coordinated visual and textual representations that generalize to language-guided pathological interpretation. More detailed ROI vision-language transfer results are shown in扩展数据图Extended Data Figure4和and扩展数据表Extended Data Table49-51.

ALICE 在滑梯多式联运方面的优势也很明显。在使用 MI-Zero 的六个 WSI 零样本分类任务中The strengths of ALICE were also evident in slide-level multimodal transfer. In six WSI zero-shot classification tasks using MI-Zero40，基于平衡准确度，ALICE 取得了 1.17 的最佳平均排名（详细结果参见, ALICE achieved the best average rank of 1.17 based on balanced accuracy (See detailed results in扩展数据表Extended Data Table52）。在 10 次 PathPT 中). In the 10-shot PathPT22在设置中，ALICE 的表现也优于基线模型，在 6 个小样本分类任务中取得了 1.17 的平均排名。例如，在脑肿瘤亚型和儿科罕见肿瘤分类中，ALICE 在不同样本量上取得了有竞争力或更好的平均表现（图setting, ALICE also outperformed the baseline models, achieving an average rank of 1.17 across six few-shot classification tasks. For example, in brain tumor subtyping and pediatric rare tumor classification, ALICE achieved competitive or better average performance across sample sizes (Figure3b），证明其多模态表示在数据有限的幻灯片级诊断设置中的有效性。更多使用 PathPT 的 WSI 少样本分类结果可以在b), demonstrating the effectiveness of its multimodal representations in data-limited slide-level diagnostic settings. 定性分析进一步证实了 ALICE 学到的多模态对齐能力。在文本到图像检索中，ALICE 检索到的组织学区域在形态上与查询描述和相应的真实标签一致，包括具有筛状结构和粉刺坏死相关特征的前列腺病变。Qualitative analysis further confirmed the multimodal alignment capability learned by ALICE. In WSI-level prediction, by mapping patch-level target-class scores back onto the original WSI, the evidence heatmap for nephroblastoma highlighted diagnostically significant tumor regions, and the highest-scoring regions showed cellular and structural patterns consistent with the slide-level prediction (图Figure3d）。这些例子表明 ALICE 可以将文本病理学概念与本地视觉证据联系起来。更具代表性的 ROI 文本到图像、图像到文本和 WSI 热图显示在). These examples demonstrate that ALICE can link textual pathology concepts with local visual evidence. 临床 WSI 分析通常超出基于形态学的玻片分类，因为许多临床相关终点需要组织学证据和疾病特异性临床背景的联合解释。血管侵犯检测等任务Clinical WSI analysis often extends beyond morphology-based slide classification, as many clinically relevant endpoints require joint interpretation of histological evidence and disease-specific clinical context. Tasks such as vascular invasion detection16和治疗反应预测and treatment response prediction12可能涉及仅通过图像形态学无法完全捕获的诊断线索。因此，我们使用 MICA 进一步评估了 ALICEmay involve diagnostic clues that cannot be fully captured by image morphology alone. Therefore, we further evaluated ALICE using the MICA36九种多模式临床 WSI 分析任务的适配器，涵盖乳腺癌、头颈癌、卵巢癌和皮肤黑色素瘤（adapter on nine multimodal clinical WSI analysis tasks covering breast cancer, head and neck cancer, ovarian cancer, and cutaneous melanoma (图Figure3e和and扩展数据表Extended Data Table59）。 ALICE 在这些任务上取得了优异的表现，包括腋窝淋巴结转移分类、角化鳞状细胞癌分级、淋巴血管和血管侵犯检测、卵巢癌治疗反应预测、肿瘤起源分类和黑色素瘤复发预测。为了检查每种模态的贡献，我们比较了 ALICE 在代表性任务上的纯文本版本、纯 WSI 版本和多模态版本（). ALICE achieved strong performance across these tasks, including axillary lymph node metastasis classification, keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma grading, lymphovascular and vascular invasion detection, ovarian cancer treatment response prediction, tumor origin classification, and melanoma recurrence prediction. To examine the contribution of each modality, we compared text-only, WSI-only, and multimodal versions of ALICE on representative tasks (图Figure3f）。多模式版本在所有评估设置中实现了最高性能，特别是在血管侵犯检测和肿瘤起源分类方面。这些结果表明，ALICE 可以使用临床文本表示作为 WSI 形态学的补充信息，为复杂的临床诊断任务提供更强大的多模态幻灯片级推理。). The multimodal version achieved the highest performance across all evaluation settings, particularly in vascular invasion detection and tumor origin classification. These results demonstrate that ALICE can use clinical text representations as supplementary information to WSI morphology, providing more robust multimodal slide-level inference for complex clinical diagnostic tasks.

2.3 ALICE 具有高分辨率 WSI 功能，性能优于滑动级 PFMALICE outperforms slide-level PFMs with high-resolution WSI features

与 ROI 级或图块级特征传输不同，幻灯片级病理学基础模型旨在将整个幻灯片图像的全局形态、空间组织和组织异质性编码为紧凑的幻灯片表示Unlike ROI-level or tile-level feature transfer, slide-level pathology foundation models aim to encode the global morphology, spatial organization, and tissue heterogeneity of whole-slide images into compact slide representations67, 15, 64, 68。此设置对于诊断证据分布在大组织区域或取决于载玻片的整体架构背景的临床任务尤其重要，例如生物标志物预测和生存分析。我们将 ALICE 与两个代表性幻灯片级 PFM（TITAN 和 CARE）在七个代表性 WSI 任务场景中进行了比较，包括使用 KNN 和线性探测的 WSI 诊断分类、WSI 少样本分类、幻灯片间检索、生物标志物预测、生存分析和特定于任务的微调。. This setting is particularly important for clinical tasks in which diagnostic evidence is distributed across large tissue areas or depends on the overall architectural context of the slide, such as biomarker prediction and survival analysis. We compared ALICE with two representative slide-level PFMs, TITAN and CARE, across seven representative WSI task scenarios, including WSI diagnostic classification with KNN and linear probing, WSI few-shot classification, slide-to-slide retrieval, biomarker prediction, survival analysis, and task-specific fine-tuning.

ALICE 在滑动级传输任务中取得了最强的整体性能（ALICE achieved the strongest overall performance across slide-level transfer tasks (图Figure4a）。在 WSI 诊断分类中，ALICE 在 KNN 和线性探测设置下的 19 项任务中取得了最佳平均排名，基于平衡精度，平均排名分别为 1.53 和 1.47。 ALICE 还在 21 项任务的幻灯片到幻灯片检索（1.62，MVAcc@3）、7 项任务的 WSI 生物标志物预测（1.71，AUC）以及 6 项任务的 WSI 生存分析（1.67，C 指数）方面取得了最佳平均排名。这些结果表明 ALICE 提取的 WSI 特征可推广到形态驱动和临床导向的幻灯片级预测任务。详细的载玻片水平诊断、生物标志物和生存结果提供于). In WSI diagnostic classification, ALICE achieved the best average rank across 19 tasks under both KNN and linear probing settings, with average ranks of 1.53 and 1.47 based on balanced accuracy, respectively. ALICE also achieved the best average rank in slide-to-slide retrieval across 21 tasks (1.62, MVAcc@3), WSI biomarker prediction across seven tasks (1.71, AUC), and WSI survival analysis across six tasks (1.67, C-index). These results indicate that WSI features extracted by ALICE generalize across both morphology-driven and clinically oriented slide-level prediction tasks. Detailed slide-level diagnostic, biomarker and survival results are provided in扩展数据图Extended Data Figure9和and扩展数据表Extended Data Table60-61, 63-64.

数据高效和固定特征分析进一步支持了 ALICE 的优势。在少样本泛癌症分类中，ALICE 在 CMB 和 CPTAC 上的不同样本数量上始终取得了很强的平衡准确性，这表明当只有有限的标记载玻片可用时，其载玻片级表示仍然有效（The advantage of ALICE was further supported by data-efficient and fixed-feature analyses. In few-shot pan-cancer classification, ALICE consistently achieved strong balanced accuracy across different shot numbers on both CMB and CPTAC, suggesting that its slide-level representations remain effective when only limited labeled slides are available (图Figure4b）。 CPTAC 上的 UMAP 可视化显示九种癌症类型之间存在明显区分，包括乳腺癌、透明细胞肾细胞癌、结肠腺癌、胶质母细胞瘤、头颈鳞状细胞癌、肺腺癌、肺鳞状细胞癌、卵巢癌和胰腺导管腺癌。). UMAP visualization on CPTAC showed clear separation among nine cancer types, including breast cancer, clear cell renal cell carcinoma, colon adenocarcinoma, glioblastoma, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, lung adenocarcinoma, lung squamous cell carcinoma, ovarian cancer, and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (图Figure4c）。在幻灯片到幻灯片检索中，ALICE 从三个数据源中识别出具有相同或密切相关的诊断标签的幻灯片，进一步支持其高分辨率 WSI 功能捕获全局诊断相似性的能力（). In slide-to-slide retrieval, ALICE identified slides with identical or closely related diagnostic labels from three data sources, further supporting the ability of its high-resolution WSI features to capture global diagnostic similarity (图Figure4d）。更具代表性的幻灯片到幻灯片检索示例显示在).
